import re

def tokenize(text):
    parts=[]
    cursor=0
    for match in re.finditer(r'\$\{([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\}',text):
        parts.append(('text',text[cursor:match.start()]))
        parts.append(('ref',match.group(1)))
        cursor=match.end()
    parts.append(('text',text[cursor:]))
    return parts

# template-dependency-expansion

Behavior contract:
templates.service.expand_all(values) accepts a dict of identifier keys to string templates and returns a NEW dict with every value fully expanded. A token ${NAME} references another key recursively; missing referenced keys raise KeyError and dependency cycles raise ValueError. '$$' emits one literal '$' and is never reparsed, so '$${NAME}' becomes literal '${NAME}'. Other dollar syntax is ordinary text. All keys match [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*; malformed reference syntax is literal text. Do not read environment variables or mutate values. Shared dependencies are not cycles; empty values are valid.

Run `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`.
Use only the runtime standard library. Preserve public interfaces and existing assertions; do not install dependencies or access the network.
